**Decision: Buy AAPL.**

The fiscal 2023 10-K (year ended 2023-09-30) shows a business that is still highly profitable and cash-generative even in a down revenue year: net sales of $383,285M (down from $394,328M in fiscal 2022), operating income of $114,301M, net income of $96,995M, diluted EPS of $6.13 (up from $6.11), and operating cash flow of $110,543M. The modest sales decline alongside margin resilience and rising EPS suggests stable profitability rather than deterioration, and the filing's liquidity statement supports the balance sheet. I verified those figures against the SEC-filed data.

**Order placed:** Buy 22 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.72 — the current ask, so essentially at market — for a notional of ~$4,900, within the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily caps, and well within the $50,000 cash balance (no money moved out of the account; the only other position is 20 INTC shares, left untouched). If the order had been priced at the $222.70 last trade it would have been ~$4,899, still compliant. The key figures I relied on: diluted EPS $6.13 (fiscal 2023), revenue $383,285M, net income $96,995M, and operating cash flow $110,543M.
